1–3 t/ha

5–10 t/ha compost
Humic acids buffer alkalinity. Improves water retention and micronutrient availability in alkaline soils.
output.timing:
For alkaline soils, apply gypsum before the rainy season and incorporate by tilling.
Elemental sulphur requires warm, moist soil and 6–12 months for bacteria to react — plan ahead.
Grow green manures (Mucuna, Sesbania) to add organic acids and improve sodic soils.
Avoid flood irrigation which can worsen sodicity — use drip or furrow irrigation if possible.
Test soil again after 1–2 seasons to check if pH has improved.
